decisions.summary: eight procedure rows whose fix redraws a named Mode A sheet (Ubame, Hayakawa, Ochiba, the Hoshigaoka shrine sheet) re-tiered E1 -> E3
decisions.why: FR-003 of the accepted spec tiers a hand-drawn sheet redrawn E3, and each row's own files list names the sheet; ranking by implementation work is what the GM asked for

decisions.summary: the procedure row 'Outer court#archery bank' re-tiered E1 -> E3 under D5's reason ('the fix redraws a hand-drawn Mode A sheet')
decisions.why: the row's own fix says 'no sheet draws one' and its files list only buildings.md: it is one value in the procedure (E1). Moving it to E3 defers an easy fix behind harder ones on a premise the row contradicts, against 'go from easiest to hardest' and SC-003

decisions.summary: the procedure row 'Walls and gates#main gate posts' kept in E1 and in wave 2 although its files list the Ochiba, Hayakawa and Ubame sheets
decisions.why: not a narrowing (it does harder work earlier), but it is inconsistent with D5 and FR-003, and wave 2's tasks neither name those sheets (FR-009) nor declare an occasion for them; reported as a spec-review change

decisions.summary: the 32 E1 rows of hamletgen/ways/ held together as wave 3; consts.py FOOTPATH_FABRIC_GAP waits for that wave
decisions.why: all E1, contiguous in the ranking (measured: E1 indices 17-48), taken as the very next wave, so easiest-first order is kept; FOOTPATH_FABRIC_GAP's fix (4.0 -> 7.0) is the same fix the ways/bund.py::RunOnBlocks.clear row carries, a real dependency (SC-003), though not yet recorded in ranking.json's after field

decisions.summary: wave 2 verification: Inashiro first via make map with the PNG looked at, then the pool through the gate, bookends 328-w2-start/end, impl-drift on every touched unit
decisions.why: carries FR-005 (impl-drift IN-STEP, gate green, maps regenerated) and constitution VI; adds nothing the GM did not ask for

decisions.summary: wave 2 scope: the first sixteen E1 rows (ranking E1 indices 0-16 less FOOTPATH_FABRIC_GAP)
decisions.why: a contiguous run at the head of E1 apart from the dependency D6 names; wave size is the spec's construct (FR-006)
